claim: Every one of the 61 recovered Xbox campaign segments is present in every applicable final offline audit, with 692 passing per-map gate cells and no silent coverage gap.

interpretation.green_cell: The named final report contains the map and has no applicable failure record.
interpretation.coop_raw_script_entity_boundary: The raw report's 60 unprofiled records are accepted only through the separate reachability report, which records zero port regression.

limits: The matrix detects report/map coverage gaps; it does not independently reimplement each underlying audit.
A green offline cell is not native loader, gameplay, networking, collision-trace, visibility, lighting, timing, save/load or visual-fidelity acceptance.
Attention and source-residue records remain in the hashed source reports and require the focused native observations already documented.
